metadata.description: An explicit edge to firebase:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point cannot compile before the parent's dist exists, so the edge is real -- but it has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to firebase:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory. The implicitDependencies on date / model / rxjs exist for the same build: @nx/rollup's withNx remaps only DIRECT graph dependencies to dist, and @dereekb/firebase's declarations import those three, so without the edges TypeScript follows their tsconfig paths into source and fails with TS6059. They are implicit rather than peers because this package never imports them itself.
